name: travel-buddy
description: Travel Buddy — find student travel companions. React client + Express/MongoDB API served from a single origin.

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install --include=dev && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm start"
